negative.zh: 文字，字母，数字，签名，水印，标志，商标，界面元素，写实照片质感，三维渲染质感，塑料质感，模糊，虚焦，噪点，压缩痕迹，抗锯齿柔边，平滑渐变，透视错误，比例失调，多余或缺失的肢体，多余的手指，畸形，重复的主体，主体被裁切，背景杂物，投影，过曝，低对比，色带，扭曲的网格，格子之间互相粘连，格子分隔线
negative.en: text, letters, numbers, signature, watermark, logo, trademark, user interface elements, photorealistic, 3D render look, plastic look, blurry, out of focus, noise, compression artifacts, anti-aliased soft edges, smooth gradients, wrong perspective, bad proportions, extra or missing limbs, extra fingers, deformed, duplicated subject, cropped subject, cluttered background, drop shadow, overexposed, low contrast, color banding, warped grid, cells touching each other, grid lines

lothar_plain.name: 洛萨乡野
lothar_plain.zh: 西方奇幻边陲的温带乡镇：灰泥半木屋、原木小屋、陶红与赭黄的瓦顶、木栅、石砌礼拜堂、铁杉林、绿草与土路；白天明快，傍晚暖金，宁静中带一点边地的寒意；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
lothar_plain.en: temperate frontier villages of a western fantasy borderland: timber-framed plaster houses, log cabins, terracotta and ochre tiled roofs, wooden palisades, a stone chapel, hemlock woods, green grass and dirt roads; bright daylight and warm golden evenings, peaceful with a hint of frontier chill; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 洛萨乡野的色调：土褐、苔绿、麦黄与暖灰，毛皮与鞣革的质感，受光带一点傍晚的暖金；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: Lotha countryside coloring: earth brown, moss green, wheat yellow and warm gray, textures of fur and tanned leather, a touch of warm evening gold on the lit side; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

valen_city.name: 瓦伦城邑
valen_city.zh: 设防的边境大城：砖石街巷、蓝灰色石板瓦、石板路、白钟大教堂、河港码头与市集雨棚、厚重的城墙；色调偏冷灰而有烟火气；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
valen_city.en: a fortified border city: brick and stone streets, blue-gray slate roofs, cobblestones, a white-bell cathedral, a river harbor and market awnings, thick city walls; cool gray tones with a lived-in warmth; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 瓦伦城邑的色调：冷灰、蓝灰、砖红与烟褐，带一点煤灰与污渍；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: Valen city coloring: cool gray, blue gray, brick red and smoky brown, with a touch of soot and grime; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

wild_forest.name: 边地野林
wild_forest.zh: 边地野林与林缘：深绿的针叶与阔叶混交林、苔藓、蕨、倒木、木瓦猎户小屋、长满苔的残垣；林下斑驳的光，湿润而幽深；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
wild_forest.en: wild frontier forest and its edge: deep green mixed conifer and broadleaf trees, moss, ferns, fallen logs, shingled hunter cabins, mossy ruined walls; dappled light under the canopy, damp and deep; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 边地野林的色调：深绿、苔绿、湿褐与树皮灰，毛皮带着湿气与青苔，受光是林下斑驳的冷光；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: wild frontier forest coloring: deep green, moss green, damp brown and bark gray, fur damp and touched with moss, cool dappled light on the lit side; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

sealed_ruins.name: 封印遗迹
sealed_ruins.zh: 封印遗迹与地下：千年前的冷灰石砌建筑、门形拱与门框残骸、倒塌的立柱、苔与水渍；没有天光，只有冷色微光与零星的暖色火光，安静而压抑；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
sealed_ruins.en: sealed ancient ruins and underground halls: cold gray masonry a thousand years old, door-shaped arches and broken door frames, toppled pillars, moss and water stains; no daylight, only a cold faint glow and scattered warm firelight, silent and oppressive; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 封印遗迹的色调：冷灰、骨白、苔青与水渍暗褐，石与骨的质感，冷色微光里夹一点暖色火光；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: sealed ruins coloring: cold gray, bone white, moss teal and water-stained dark brown, textures of stone and bone, a cold faint glow with a touch of warm firelight; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

ash_waste.name: 灰烬荒原
ash_waste.zh: 灰烬荒原：焦黑的岩地、灰白的灰烬与沙、铁锈色的岩层、石化的枯树、门框残骸、从地缝里长出的淡紫色晶体、飘落的余烬与灰；天光泛红灰，荒凉；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
ash_waste.en: ashen wasteland: scorched black rock, pale ash and sand, rust-colored strata, petrified dead trees, ruined door frames, pale violet crystals growing from cracks, drifting embers and falling ash; reddish gray skylight, desolate; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 灰烬荒原的色调：焦黑、灰白、铁锈红与淡紫晶色，主体身上可以沾着灰与余烬，受光泛红灰；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: ashen wasteland coloring: scorched black, pale ash, rust red and pale violet crystal tones, ash and embers may cling to the subject, reddish gray light; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

divine_court.name: 神庭
divine_court.zh: 神庭：白石与大理石的殿堂、金色饰边、柔和恒定的光、整齐的庭园与泉池、悬浮的光尘；庄严、洁净，没有影子反而让人不安；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
divine_court.en: the divine court: halls of white stone and marble, gold trim, soft constant light, orderly gardens and pools, floating motes of light; solemn and immaculate, the absence of shadow is unsettling; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 神庭的色调：白、象牙、柔金与浅天青，洁净无瑕的质感，柔和恒定的光；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: divine court coloring: white, ivory, soft gold and pale sky blue, immaculate textures, soft constant light; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

holy_see_white.name: 白石教国
holy_see_white.zh: 白石教国：白石穹顶与钟楼、金色的圣纹、橄榄树与葡萄园、朝圣石路、整洁的修院回廊；阳光强烈，色调白、金、橄榄绿；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
holy_see_white.en: the white-stone holy state: white domes and bell towers, golden sacred motifs, olive trees and vineyards, pilgrim stone roads, neat cloister arcades; strong sunlight, white, gold and olive green; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 白石教国的色调：白、金、橄榄绿与日晒的暖褐，强烈阳光下明暗清楚；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: white-stone holy state coloring: white, gold, olive green and sunbaked warm brown, crisp light and shadow under strong sun; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

grantia_ochre.name: 赭红帝国
grantia_ochre.zh: 赭红帝国：赭红夯土与砖石营垒、绵延的长垒城墙、圆形竞技场、军旗与制式营帐、麦田；色调赭红、钢灰、麦黄，严整而尚武；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
grantia_ochre.en: the ochre empire: ochre rammed earth and brick fortifications, long frontier walls, a round arena, war banners and regulation army tents, wheat fields; ochre red, steel gray and wheat yellow, orderly and martial; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 赭红帝国的色调：赭红、钢灰、麦黄与尘土褐，粗砺尚武的质感；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: ochre empire coloring: ochre red, steel gray, wheat yellow and dust brown, rough martial textures; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

mercato_coast.name: 海港同盟
mercato_coast.zh: 海港同盟：赤陶屋顶的港城、白帆与码头吊杆、商行拱廊、秤与钱庄的纹章招牌、被炉火映红的作坊；海蓝底色加金色点缀，繁忙富足；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
mercato_coast.en: the merchant harbor league: terracotta-roofed port towns, white sails and dock cranes, arcaded trading houses, emblem signs of scales and money changers, workshops lit red by forge fire; sea blue with gold accents, busy and prosperous; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 海港同盟的色调：海蓝、赤陶、盐白与金色点缀，带一点海水与盐渍的光泽；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: merchant harbor league coloring: sea blue, terracotta, salt white and gold accents, a sheen of seawater and salt crust; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

silva_canopy.name: 林冠秘境
silva_canopy.zh: 林冠秘境：参天巨树、树冠之间的木桥与吊台、银色树皮、雾白的林间空气、会发光的苔与花；静谧而古老，色调深绿、银、雾白；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
silva_canopy.en: the ancient canopy forest: towering giant trees, wooden bridges and platforms between the crowns, silver bark, misty white air, glowing moss and flowers; quiet and ancient, deep green, silver and mist white; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 林冠秘境的色调：深绿、银灰、雾白与发光苔的浅青绿，古老而静谧的质感；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: ancient canopy forest coloring: deep green, silver gray, mist white and the pale teal of glowing moss, ancient and quiet textures; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

windfang_steppe.name: 风牙草原
windfang_steppe.zh: 风牙草原：起伏的黄草原、高耸如獠牙的岩柱、圆形毡帐与红毡门帘、马群与角兽、辽阔的天空与大朵的云；开阔辽远，色调草黄、天蓝、毡红；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
windfang_steppe.en: the windswept steppe: rolling yellow grassland, towering fang-shaped rock pillars, round felt tents with red felt doors, herds of horses and horned beasts, a vast sky with big clouds; open and far-reaching, grass yellow, sky blue and felt red; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 风牙草原的色调：草黄、沙褐、天蓝与毡红点缀，毛发被风吹得蓬松；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: windswept steppe coloring: grass yellow, sand brown, sky blue and felt red accents, hair and fur tousled by wind; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

night_basalt.name: 黑岩夜境
night_basalt.zh: 黑岩夜境：黑色玄武岩的城堡与尖塔、暗红的灯火与熔岩裂缝、火山烟、冒着白汽的青白色温泉、骨与铁的装饰；像长夜一样幽暗而富丽；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
night_basalt.en: the basalt night realm: black basalt castles and spires, dark red lamplight and lava seams, volcanic smoke, steaming pale blue-white hot springs, ornaments of bone and iron; dim as a long night yet lavish; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 黑岩夜境的色调：玄武黑、暗红、骨白与温泉的青白，幽暗而带一点熔岩的暗光；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: basalt night realm coloring: basalt black, dark red, bone white and the pale blue-white of hot springs, dim with a faint lava glow; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

sleepscale_snow.name: 眠鳞雪岭
sleepscale_snow.zh: 眠鳞雪岭：冰蓝的峭壁与雪原、积雪的松林、冰川与冰洞、巨大的古龙骸骨、远处掠过的龙影、石砌的山间驿站；空气清冷透亮，色调冰蓝、雪白；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
sleepscale_snow.en: the sleeping-scale snow range: ice-blue cliffs and snowfields, snow-laden pines, glaciers and ice caves, giant ancient dragon bones, dragon silhouettes passing in the distance, stone mountain waystations; crisp clear cold air, ice blue and snow white; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 眠鳞雪岭的色调：冰蓝、雪白、岩灰与冷银，霜与冰晶的质感，清冷透亮的光；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: sleeping-scale snow range coloring: ice blue, snow white, rock gray and cold silver, textures of frost and ice crystals, crisp clear cold light; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

forge_deep.name: 炉火地底
forge_deep.zh: 炉火地底：矿道与地下炉城、粗凿的岩壁、铁轨与矿车、铁与黄铜的机关、熔炉与提灯的橙光、铁锈与湿苔；闷热而忙碌；中世纪奇幻，没有现代物品
forge_deep.en: forge depths: mine tunnels and underground forge halls, rough-hewn rock walls, rails and mine carts, iron and brass machinery, orange light of furnaces and lanterns, rust and damp moss; hot and busy; medieval fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 炉火地底的色调：铁灰、锈红、黄铜与炉火的橙光，金属、矿渣与湿苔的质感；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；中世纪奇幻
creature.en: forge depths coloring: iron gray, rust red, brass and the orange glow of furnaces, textures of metal, slag and damp moss; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; medieval fantasy

door_corridor.name: 门廊幽境
door_corridor.zh: 门廊幽境：无边的幽暗里层层叠叠悬浮的门与门框、门缝透出暖白偏金的微光、钥匙与锁的纹样、脚下像镜子一样的暗面；安静、神秘、像一场梦；奇幻，没有现代物品
door_corridor.en: the corridor of doors: endless darkness with layers of floating doors and door frames, warm white-gold light leaking from the door gaps, key and lock motifs, a mirror-like dark floor; silent, mysterious, dreamlike; fantasy, no modern objects

creature.zh: 门廊幽境的色调：深夜蓝、墨黑与暖白偏金的微光，安静得像一场梦；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；奇幻
creature.en: corridor of doors coloring: midnight blue, ink black and a faint warm white-gold glow, quiet as a dream; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; fantasy

earth_modern.name: 地球日常
earth_modern.zh: 当代地球的日常小场景：末班电车的车厢、雨夜的便利店、医院走廊、正在清空的老宅；荧光灯与雨水的反光，疲惫而安静；招牌、屏幕与包装上没有任何文字
earth_modern.en: small everyday scenes of present-day Earth: a last-train carriage, a convenience store on a rainy night, a hospital corridor, an old house being emptied; fluorescent light and rain reflections, tired and quiet; signs, screens and packaging carry no lettering

creature.zh: 当代地球的色调：日常的自然色，荧光灯下偏冷的受光与雨水的湿润反光；只画主体本身，不画任何景物与地面；身上没有任何文字
creature.en: present-day Earth coloring: everyday natural colors, cool fluorescent light and wet rain reflections on the subject; draw only the subject itself, no scenery and no ground; no lettering anywhere

chr_turnaround.title: 人物三视图参照（Q 版三视图加正常比例胸像）
chr_turnaround.frames: 第 1 格面向镜头的正面全身，第 2 格朝画面右方的侧面全身，第 3 格背向镜头的背面全身，第 4 格正常比例胸像（给头像与半身立绘作参照）；只作参照图，不入游戏
chr_turnaround.zh: {subject}。角色设定稿：同一人物的三视图与胸像，干净平涂，线条清晰，色块分明，第 1 到 3 格为 Q 版约 1.7 头身的全身，第 4 格为正常比例的胸像。{style}。四格从左到右：面向镜头的正面全身、朝画面右方的侧面全身、背向镜头的背面全身、正常比例胸像。四格中的发型、服装、配色与标志物完全一致，站姿自然放松，双臂略离开身体，全身完整入画，三张全身像的脚底在同一条基线上。浅灰色平涂背景。{extra}
chr_turnaround.en: {subject}. Character model sheet: a turnaround of one character plus a bust, clean flat colors, crisp lines, clear color blocks, panels 1 to 3 are full-body chibi figures about 1.7 heads tall, panel 4 is a normal-proportion bust. {style}. Four panels from left to right: full-body front view facing the viewer, full-body side view facing screen right, full-body back view facing away, normal-proportion bust. Hairstyle, outfit, colors and signature items are identical in all panels, relaxed standing pose, arms held slightly away from the body, whole body inside the frame, the three full-body figures stand on one baseline. Flat light gray background. {extra}

chr_idle.title: 人物动作条：待机
chr_idle.frames: 列 1 到 4：待机循环 4 帧（呼吸起伏，第 2、4 帧身体下沉 1 像素）；行 1 面向镜头（下），行 2 朝画面右方（右），行 3 背向镜头（上）；左向由右向镜像生成，不画
chr_idle.zh: {subject}。像素画动作条：待机循环 4 帧，轻微的呼吸起伏。{style}。像素画，高清像素微缩场景里的立牌角色，带现代光影的像素立体透视场景风格，略带俯视的正面角色视角，Q 版约 1.7 头身，人物约占格高的六成，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（取邻近色的深色，不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限，不画投影，不画地面。网格排布：3 行 4 列，第 1 行面向镜头，第 2 行朝画面右方，第 3 行背向镜头，每行从左到右是连续帧，每格大小一致、等距，人物水平居中，脚底对齐同一条基线，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
chr_idle.en: {subject}. Pixel art animation strip: a 4-frame idle loop with subtle breathing. {style}. Pixel art, standee character for a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, slightly elevated front-facing sprite angle, chibi proportions about 1.7 heads tall, the character fills about 60 percent of the cell height, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline made of darkened neighbor colors (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette, no cast shadow, no ground. Grid layout: 3 rows by 4 columns, row 1 faces the viewer, row 2 faces screen right, row 3 faces away, each row reads left to right as consecutive frames, equal cells evenly spaced, character centered horizontally, feet on the same baseline in every cell, no grid lines. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

chr_walk.title: 人物动作条：行走
chr_walk.frames: 列 1 到 6：行走循环 6 帧，第 1、4 帧为着地帧（脚步声）；行 1 下，行 2 右，行 3 上；左向由右向镜像
chr_walk.zh: {subject}。像素画动作条：行走循环 6 帧，左右脚交替，第 1、4 帧脚跟着地，手臂自然摆动。{style}。像素画，高清像素微缩场景里的立牌角色，带现代光影的像素立体透视场景风格，略带俯视的正面角色视角，Q 版约 1.7 头身，人物约占格高的六成，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（取邻近色的深色，不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限，不画投影，不画地面。网格排布：3 行 6 列，第 1 行面向镜头，第 2 行朝画面右方，第 3 行背向镜头，每行从左到右是连续帧，每格大小一致、等距，人物水平居中，脚底对齐同一条基线，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
chr_walk.en: {subject}. Pixel art animation strip: a 6-frame walk cycle, alternating feet, heel contact on frames 1 and 4, arms swinging naturally. {style}. Pixel art, standee character for a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, slightly elevated front-facing sprite angle, chibi proportions about 1.7 heads tall, the character fills about 60 percent of the cell height, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline made of darkened neighbor colors (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette, no cast shadow, no ground. Grid layout: 3 rows by 6 columns, row 1 faces the viewer, row 2 faces screen right, row 3 faces away, each row reads left to right as consecutive frames, equal cells evenly spaced, character centered horizontally, feet on the same baseline in every cell, no grid lines. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

chr_run.title: 人物动作条：奔跑

chr_emote.zh: {subject}。像素画动作表：情绪动作 16 帧，全部面向镜头，按行从左到右每 2 帧一组，依次为点头、摇头、挥手、鞠躬、欢呼、垂头沮丧、生气跺脚、受惊后退；表情随动作变化。{style}。像素画，高清像素微缩场景里的立牌角色，带现代光影的像素立体透视场景风格，略带俯视的正面角色视角，Q 版约 1.7 头身，人物约占格高的六成，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（取邻近色的深色，不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限，不画投影，不画地面。网格排布：4 行 4 列，每格大小一致、等距，人物水平居中，脚底对齐同一条基线，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
chr_emote.en: {subject}. Pixel art emote sheet: 16 frames all facing the viewer, read row by row left to right in pairs, nod, shake head, wave, bow, cheer, slump in disappointment, stomp in anger, flinch back in fright; facial expression follows each emote. {style}. Pixel art, standee character for a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, slightly elevated front-facing sprite angle, chibi proportions about 1.7 heads tall, the character fills about 60 percent of the cell height, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline made of darkened neighbor colors (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette, no cast shadow, no ground. Grid layout: 4 rows by 4 columns, equal cells evenly spaced, character centered horizontally, feet on the same baseline, no grid lines. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

chr_signature.title: 人物动作条：专属小动作
chr_signature.frames: 列 1 到 4：角色专属的待机小动作循环（内容见补充说明）；行 1 下，行 2 右，行 3 上；左向由右向镜像
chr_signature.zh: {subject}。像素画动作条：角色专属的小动作循环 4 帧，动作见补充说明，动作幅度小，第 4 帧能自然接回第 1 帧。{style}。像素画，高清像素微缩场景里的立牌角色，带现代光影的像素立体透视场景风格，略带俯视的正面角色视角，Q 版约 1.7 头身，人物约占格高的六成，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（取邻近色的深色，不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限，不画投影，不画地面。网格排布：3 行 4 列，第 1 行面向镜头，第 2 行朝画面右方，第 3 行背向镜头，每行从左到右是连续帧，每格大小一致、等距，人物水平居中，脚底对齐同一条基线，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
chr_signature.en: {subject}. Pixel art animation strip: a 4-frame signature idle quirk of this character, described in the extra notes, small movements, frame 4 loops naturally back to frame 1. {style}. Pixel art, standee character for a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, slightly elevated front-facing sprite angle, chibi proportions about 1.7 heads tall, the character fills about 60 percent of the cell height, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline made of darkened neighbor colors (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette, no cast shadow, no ground. Grid layout: 3 rows by 4 columns, row 1 faces the viewer, row 2 faces screen right, row 3 faces away, each row reads left to right as consecutive frames, equal cells evenly spaced, character centered horizontally, feet on the same baseline, no grid lines. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

chr_ride.title: 人物动作条：骑乘（只画骑手）
chr_ride.frames: 列 1、2 骑乘待机，列 3 到 6 骑乘行进；行 1 下，行 2 右，行 3 上；左向由右向镜像；骑手按坐骑鞍位锚点叠在坐骑上
chr_ride.zh: {subject}。像素画动作条：骑乘 6 帧，第 1、2 帧骑乘待机，第 3 到 6 帧随坐骑行进而上下起伏；人物跨坐，双手握缰，不画坐骑，身体下方留空给坐骑的鞍位。{style}。像素画，高清像素微缩场景里的立牌角色，带现代光影的像素立体透视场景风格，略带俯视的正面角色视角，Q 版约 1.7 头身，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（取邻近色的深色，不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限，不画投影，不画地面。网格排布：3 行 6 列，第 1 行面向镜头，第 2 行朝画面右方，第 3 行背向镜头，每行从左到右是连续帧，每格大小一致、等距，人物水平居中，臀部对齐同一条水平线，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
chr_ride.en: {subject}. Pixel art animation strip: 6 frames of riding, frames 1 and 2 are a mounted idle, frames 3 to 6 bob with the mount's stride; the rider sits astride holding the reins, no mount drawn, empty space below the body for the mount's saddle. {style}. Pixel art, standee character for a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, slightly elevated front-facing sprite angle, chibi proportions about 1.7 heads tall, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline made of darkened neighbor colors (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette, no cast shadow, no ground. Grid layout: 3 rows by 6 columns, row 1 faces the viewer, row 2 faces screen right, row 3 faces away, each row reads left to right as consecutive frames, equal cells evenly spaced, character centered horizontally, hips aligned on one horizontal line, no grid lines. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

doll_mannequin.title: 纸娃娃固定人台三视图（每种体型一张）
doll_mannequin.frames: 第 1 格面向镜头，第 2 格朝画面右方，第 3 格背向镜头；人台的全部动作条用 chr_ 系列模板生成，并以本图为参照；只作参照，不入游戏
doll_mannequin.zh: {subject}。纸娃娃固定人台的设定稿：中性灰色的光头人台，没有头发、没有衣服细节、没有性别特征，脸上只有两个简单的眼位，双手半握成能握住武器与工具的形状，Q 版约 1.7 头身，干净平涂，线条清晰。{style}。三格从左到右：面向镜头的正面、朝画面右方的侧面、背向镜头的背面，三格的身高、头身比与站姿完全一致，脚底在同一条基线上。浅灰色平涂背景。{extra}
doll_mannequin.en: {subject}. Model sheet of the fixed paper-doll mannequin: a neutral gray bald mannequin, no hair, no clothing detail, no gender features, only two simple eye marks on the face, hands half closed in a grip that can hold weapons and tools, chibi proportions about 1.7 heads tall, clean flat colors, crisp lines. {style}. Three panels from left to right: front view facing the viewer, side view facing screen right, back view facing away, identical height, head ratio and stance in all three, feet on one baseline. Flat light gray background. {extra}

doll_outfit_ref.title: 纸娃娃服装三视图（穿在固定人台上）
doll_outfit_ref.frames: 第 1 格正面，第 2 格右侧面，第 3 格背面；服装的动作条用 chr_ 系列模板生成，并以本图和人台动作条为参照；只作参照，不入游戏
doll_outfit_ref.zh: {subject}。纸娃娃服装设定稿：把这套服装穿在固定的灰色光头人台上，人台的身高、头身比与站姿保持不变，只画服装、鞋与腰带，不画头发与头饰，人台的头保持灰色光头。服装的主色用纯红色系平涂，副色用纯蓝色系，皮革用棕色系，金属用灰色系，点缀用绿色系（这些是给游戏换色用的键色）。干净平涂，线条清晰，Q 版约 1.7 头身。{style}。三格从左到右：正面、朝画面右方的侧面、背面，脚底在同一条基线上。浅灰色平涂背景。{extra}
doll_outfit_ref.en: {subject}. Paper-doll outfit model sheet: this outfit worn by the fixed gray bald mannequin, the mannequin's height, head ratio and stance unchanged, draw only the clothes, shoes and belt, no hair or headwear, the mannequin's head stays gray and bald. Paint the outfit's primary color in pure red tones, secondary in pure blue tones, leather in brown tones, metal in gray tones, accents in green tones (these are key colors for in-game recoloring). Clean flat colors, crisp lines, chibi proportions about 1.7 heads tall. {style}. Three panels from left to right: front, side view facing screen right, back, feet on one baseline. Flat light gray background. {extra}

doll_head.title: 纸娃娃头部件（头型、发型、耳角、头饰、胡须），四向两层
doll_head.frames: 列 1 面向镜头（下），列 2 朝画面右方（右），列 3 背向镜头（上），列 4 朝画面左方（左，头部件单独画左向，不镜像）；行 1 前层（脸前的部分：前发、头饰前沿、胡须、耳），行 2 后层（后脑后的部分：后发、头饰后沿）；只有一层的部件把行 2 留空；颈部接点在每格底边正中
doll_head.zh: {subject}。像素画纸娃娃头部件：只画这个部件本身，不画身体，按 Q 版约 1.7 头身人物的头部比例绘制，头宽约占格宽的一半。头发主色用纯黄色系平涂，肤色用浅米色系，金属用灰色系（这些是给游戏换色用的键色）。硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限。{style}。网格排布：2 行 4 列，4 列依次为面向镜头、朝画面右方、背向镜头、朝画面左方；第 1 行是挡在脸前的前层，第 2 行是在后脑后面的后层；每格中部件位置一致，颈部接点在格子底边正中，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
doll_head.en: {subject}. Pixel art paper-doll head part: draw only this part, no body, sized for the head of a chibi character about 1.7 heads tall, the head about half the cell width. Paint hair in pure yellow tones, skin in light beige tones, metal in gray tones (key colors for in-game recoloring). Hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette. {style}. Grid layout: 2 rows by 4 columns, the four columns face the viewer, screen right, away, and screen left; row 1 is the front layer in front of the face, row 2 is the back layer behind the head; the part sits at the same place in every cell, the neck joint at the bottom center of each cell, no grid lines. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

doll_face.title: 纸娃娃表情件（眼与嘴，正面）
doll_face.frames: 行 1、2 为 8 种眼：睁、半睁、闭、亮、笑眯、痛、瞪大、低垂；行 3 为 4 种嘴：无、点、张、笑；行 4 为 2 种嘴：圆、撇，其余 2 格留空；全部为面向镜头的正面，贴在头型的脸部锚点上
doll_face.zh: {subject}。像素画表情件：Q 版小人脸上的眼睛与嘴，正面，每格只画一种眼或一种嘴，极简，眼睛是竖向 2 到 3 像素的小块，嘴是 1 到 3 像素的短线或小块。行 1、2 是 8 种眼：睁开、半睁、闭上、发亮、笑眯、痛苦、瞪大、低垂；行 3 是 4 种嘴：不画、一点、张开、笑；行 4 是圆嘴与撇嘴，最后 2 格留空。硬边像素，不抗锯齿，色数极少。{style}。网格排布：4 行 4 列，每格居中，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景。{extra}
doll_face.en: {subject}. Pixel art facial expression parts: eyes and mouths for a tiny chibi face, front view, one eye pair or one mouth per cell, extremely minimal, eyes are vertical blocks 2 to 3 pixels tall, mouths are 1 to 3 pixel lines or blocks. Rows 1 and 2 hold 8 eye states: open, half open, closed, sparkling, smiling, pained, wide, downcast; row 3 holds 4 mouths: none, dot, open, smile; row 4 holds a round mouth and a frown, last 2 cells empty. Hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, very few colors. {style}. Grid layout: 4 rows by 4 columns, each centered, no grid lines. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background. {extra}

doll_held.title: 纸娃娃手持物（武器、工具、标志物），八个握持角度
doll_held.frames: 8 个握持角度，按行从左到右：从尖端竖直向上开始顺时针每 45 度一格；握柄中心位于每格正中（手部锚点）
doll_held.zh: {subject}。像素画手持物件：只画这一件武器、工具或标志物本身，不画手，大小按 Q 版小人手里的比例，每米约 16 像素。8 个角度：从尖端竖直朝上开始，按顺时针每格转 45 度，按行从左到右排列；每格里握柄的中心都在格子正中。主体颜色保持固有色，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限，不画投影。{style}。网格排布：2 行 4 列，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
doll_held.en: {subject}. Pixel art held item: draw only this weapon, tool or token, no hand, scaled for a chibi character's grip, about 16 pixels per meter. Eight angles starting with the tip pointing straight up and rotating 45 degrees clockwise per cell, read row by row left to right; the center of the grip sits at the exact center of every cell. Keep the item's natural colors, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette, no cast shadow. {style}. Grid layout: 2 rows by 4 columns, no grid lines. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

doll_back.title: 纸娃娃后挂件（披风、尾、翼、背负），三向两帧摆动
doll_back.frames: 列 1 面向镜头，列 2 朝画面右方，列 3 背向镜头；行 1 静止，行 2 摆动；部件在格内的位置与人物帧格一致（脚底锚点在格底正中上方 4 像素处）
doll_back.zh: {subject}。像素画纸娃娃后挂件：只画这个部件本身（披风、尾巴、翅膀或背负物），不画身体，大小与位置按站在格子里的 Q 版约 1.7 头身小人摆放，好像穿在一个看不见的人身上。主色用纯红色系，副色用纯蓝色系，毛发用纯黄色系（换色键色），硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限。{style}。网格排布：2 行 3 列，3 列依次为面向镜头、朝画面右方、背向镜头，第 1 行静止，第 2 行随风或随步伐摆动，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
doll_back.en: {subject}. Pixel art paper-doll back attachment: draw only this part (cape, tail, wings or something carried on the back), no body, sized and placed as if worn by an invisible chibi character about 1.7 heads tall standing in the cell. Paint the primary color in pure red tones, secondary in pure blue tones, fur in pure yellow tones (recoloring key colors), hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette. {style}. Grid layout: 2 rows by 3 columns, the three columns face the viewer, screen right and away, row 1 at rest, row 2 swaying with wind or stride, no grid lines. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

por_main.title: 主要角色像素头像表情表（8 种）
por_main.frames: 行 1：中性、微笑、开怀或得意、生气；行 2：悲伤、惊讶、思索、角色专属表情（见补充说明）
por_main.zh: {subject}。像素画头像表情表：同一人物的 8 个头像，头与肩入画，略侧的四分之三角度，正常比例，眼睛与表情清楚，八格中的发型、服装、配色与脸型完全一致，只有表情变化。行 1 依次为中性、微笑、开怀或得意、生气；行 2 依次为悲伤、惊讶、思索、角色专属表情。{style}。像素画，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，约 32 色以内，不画背景与边框。网格排布：2 行 4 列，每格人物位置与大小一致，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
por_main.en: {subject}. Pixel art portrait expression sheet: 8 portraits of the same character, head and shoulders, slight three-quarter angle, normal proportions, clear eyes and expressions, hairstyle, outfit, colors and face shape identical in all eight, only the expression changes. Row 1: neutral, smile, laughing or smug, angry; row 2: sad, surprised, thoughtful, the character's signature expression. {style}. Pixel art, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline (never pure black), light from the upper left, about 32 colors or fewer, no background and no frame. Grid layout: 2 rows by 4 columns, the character has the same position and size in every cell, no grid lines. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

por_npc.title: 有名 NPC 像素头像表情表（4 种）
por_npc.frames: 行 1：中性、高兴；行 2：生气、担忧
por_npc.zh: {subject}。像素画头像表情表：同一人物的 4 个头像，头与肩入画，略侧的四分之三角度，正常比例，四格中的发型、服装、配色与脸型完全一致，只有表情变化。依次为中性、高兴、生气、担忧。{style}。像素画，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，约 32 色以内，不画背景与边框。网格排布：2 行 2 列，每格人物位置与大小一致，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
por_npc.en: {subject}. Pixel art portrait expression sheet: 4 portraits of the same character, head and shoulders, slight three-quarter angle, normal proportions, hairstyle, outfit, colors and face shape identical in all four, only the expression changes. In order: neutral, happy, angry, worried. {style}. Pixel art, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline (never pure black), light from the upper left, about 32 colors or fewer, no background and no frame. Grid layout: 2 rows by 2 columns, the character has the same position and size in every cell, no grid lines. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

bust_base.title: 半身立绘（对话与过场用，基础表情）
bust_base.frames: 单张，腰部以上，中性表情；脸部锚点（双眼中点）由导入时标注，供表情差分对齐
bust_base.zh: {subject}。像素画半身立绘：腰部以上，正常比例，身体略侧，面向画面左前方，中性表情，双手动作自然，服装与配饰细节清楚。{style}。高精度像素画，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，约 48 色以内，有清楚的明暗面，不画背景、边框与投影。人物占满画面高度，头顶留少量空白。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
bust_base.en: {subject}. Pixel art half-body portrait: waist up, normal proportions, body turned slightly, facing toward the front left of the frame, neutral expression, natural hand pose, clear outfit and accessory detail. {style}. High-detail pixel art, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline (never pure black), light from the upper left, about 48 colors or fewer, clear light and shadow planes, no background, frame or cast shadow. The character fills the frame height with a little space above the head. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

bust_expr.title: 半身立绘的表情差分（头肩区域）
bust_expr.frames: 6 种表情的头肩区域，按行从左到右：微笑、生气、悲伤、惊讶、思索、角色专属表情；每格的取景与基础半身立绘的头肩区域完全一致，导入时按脸部锚点贴回
bust_expr.zh: {subject}。像素画表情差分：以参照的半身立绘为准，只重画头与肩部区域，取景、角度、大小、发型、服装与配色和参照完全一致，只改变表情。6 格按行从左到右依次为微笑、生气、悲伤、惊讶、思索、角色专属表情。{style}。高精度像素画，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数与参照一致。网格排布：2 行 3 列，格间不画分隔线。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
bust_expr.en: {subject}. Pixel art expression variants: following the reference half-body portrait exactly, redraw only the head and shoulder area, with framing, angle, size, hairstyle, outfit and colors identical to the reference, changing only the expression. mon_drake.en: {subject}. Pixel art monster animation sheet: a drake or wyvern standing on two hind legs, forelimbs turned into wings or kept small, long neck and long tail, clear scales and horns, never drawn as a wolf-like or dog-like quadruped. {style}. Pixel art, standee for a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, slightly elevated view, about 16 pixels per meter, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline made of darkened neighbor colors (never pure black), the lit side of the outline one step brighter, light from the upper left, limited palette, instantly readable silhouette, no cast shadow, no ground. vfx_large.title: 特效序列帧：大（范围法术、首领大招、开门，约 8 米内）
vfx_large.frames: 8 帧，按行从左到右播放；加色混合；不得遮盖地面预警（预警画在特效之上）
vfx_large.zh: {subject}。像素画特效序列帧：8 帧，按行从左到右播放，大范围的爆发或成形，有清楚的起势、高潮与消散，发光的像素，3 到 6 阶颜色，中心区域留出通透感不画成实心色块，不画描边，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，每帧的特效中心都在格子正中，范围约 8 米以内。{style}。网格排布：2 行 4 列，格间不画分隔线。纯黑色 #000000 背景（加色混合用）。{extra}
vfx_large.en: {subject}. Pixel art effect sequence: 8 frames read row by row left to right, a large burst or formation with clear build-up, peak and fade, glowing pixels in 3 to 6 color steps, keep the center see-through rather than a solid blob, no outlines, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, the effect centered in every cell, within about 8 meters. {style}. Grid layout: 2 rows by 4 columns, no grid lines. Solid pure black #000000 background (for additive blending). {extra}

vfx_projectile.title: 弹道循环帧（朝右飞行，导入时预转 16 个方向）
vfx_projectile.frames: 4 帧循环，飞行方向朝画面右方，弹头在右；导入工具按 16 个方向预转；圆形弹道不分方向
vfx_projectile.zh: {subject}。像素画弹道循环帧：4 帧循环，飞行方向朝画面右方，头部在右、尾迹向左，发光的像素，2 到 4 阶颜色，不画描边，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，每帧中心都在格子正中，第 4 帧能接回第 1 帧。{style}。网格排布：1 行 4 列，格间不画分隔线。纯黑色 #000000 背景（加色混合用）。{extra}
vfx_projectile.en: {subject}. Pixel art projectile loop: 4 looping frames flying toward screen right, head on the right and trail to the left, glowing pixels in 2 to 4 color steps, no outlines, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, centered in every cell, frame 4 loops back to frame 1. {style}. Grid layout: 1 row by 4 columns, no grid lines. Solid pure black #000000 background (for additive blending). {extra}

vfx_loop.title: 循环特效（光环、持续区域、引导、眩晕光点）
vfx_loop.frames: 8 帧循环，按行从左到右，首尾帧无缝衔接；加色混合
vfx_loop.zh: {subject}。像素画循环特效：8 帧循环，按行从左到右播放，第 8 帧能无缝接回第 1 帧，亮度起伏平缓，发光的像素，2 到 4 阶颜色，不画描边，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，每帧中心都在格子正中。{style}。网格排布：2 行 4 列，格间不画分隔线。纯黑色 #000000 背景（加色混合用）。{extra}
vfx_loop.en: {subject}. Pixel art looping effect: 8 looping frames read row by row left to right, frame 8 joins seamlessly back to frame 1, gentle brightness changes, glowing pixels in 2 to 4 color steps, no outlines, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, centered in every cell. {style}. Grid layout: 2 rows by 4 columns, no grid lines. Solid pure black #000000 background (for additive blending). {extra}

vfx_overlay.title: 叠加纹样贴图（澱源纹样、冰霜、焦痕、受损裂纹，贴在立牌或墙面轮廓内）
vfx_overlay.frames: 单张四方无缝灰度纹样，亮处为纹样，暗处透明；渲染层按立牌或墙面的轮廓遮罩后着色
vfx_overlay.zh: {subject}。像素画叠加纹样：一张四方无缝的灰度纹样贴图，亮处是纹样（裂纹、瓷纹、菌斑、字样般的刻痕、门形空洞一类），暗处为纯黑，纹样分布均匀，没有一眼可见的重复中心，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，不画描边，纹样中的刻痕不构成任何可读文字。{style}。纯黑色 #000000 背景。{extra}
vfx_overlay.en: {subject}. Pixel art overlay pattern: a seamlessly tileable grayscale pattern texture, bright pixels form the pattern (cracks, porcelain veins, fungal spots, glyph-like scratches, door-shaped hollows and the like), dark areas pure black, evenly distributed with no obvious focal point, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no outlines, the scratches never form readable writing. {style}. Solid pure black #000000 background. {extra}

ui_card.title: 界面卡片底图（神谕卡、鉴定卡、公会卡、章节卡等，非像素）
ui_card.frames: 单张卡片底图；中间大面积留给界面文字，纹样集中在四边与四角
ui_card.zh: {subject}。界面卡片底图：平面纹样插画（不是像素画），干净现代，纹样与图案集中在四边与四角，中间大面积是平静的底色留给文字，配色克制，两到四种颜色，不写任何文字、字母与数字，不画按钮。{style}。{extra}
ui_card.en: {subject}. Interface card background: flat ornamental illustration (not pixel art), clean and modern, patterns and motifs kept to the edges and corners, a large calm area in the middle left for text, restrained colors with two to four hues, no text, letters or numbers, no buttons. {style}. {extra}

ui_ornament.title: 界面角花与分隔纹样（非像素）
ui_ornament.frames: 单个纹样居中；角花朝左上角，界面按需旋转与镜像
ui_ornament.zh: {subject}。界面纹样：平面线描纹样（不是像素画），单色或双色，线条粗细统一，边缘干净，造型简洁，可作角花或分隔线，不写任何文字，不画阴影与立体效果。{style}。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
ui_ornament.en: {subject}. Interface ornament: flat line ornament (not pixel art), one or two colors, uniform line weight, clean edges, simple shapes, usable as a corner piece or divider, no text, no shading or 3D effect. {style}. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

ui_frame.title: 九宫格边框（四角纹样加可拉伸的四边，非像素）
ui_frame.frames: 单张方形边框：四角为纹样，四边为可重复拉伸的简单线条，中间完全留空；导入时按九宫格切分
ui_frame.zh: {subject}。界面九宫格边框：平面线描风格（不是像素画），一个方形边框，四个角是对称的纹样，四条边是可以重复拉伸的简单线条，中间完全留空，单色或双色，线条粗细统一，不写任何文字，不画阴影与立体效果。{style}。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，边框中间也是洋红色。{extra}
ui_frame.en: {subject}. Interface nine-slice frame: flat line style (not pixel art), one square frame with symmetrical ornaments in the four corners and simple stretchable lines along the four edges, the middle completely empty, one or two colors, uniform line weight, no text, no shading or 3D effect. {style}. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background, the inside of the frame also magenta. {extra}

ui_screen.title: 标题、载入与章节画面背景（像素插画）
ui_screen.frames: 单张 16:9 背景，按整数倍放大显示；标题与按钮的位置留空（见补充说明）
ui_screen.zh: {subject}。标题或载入画面背景：高精度像素画，高清像素微缩场景，带现代光影的像素立体透视场景风格，氛围强烈，构图在补充说明指定的区域留出安静的空位给标题与按钮，画面里没有文字与界面，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，色数有限。{style}。{extra}
ui_screen.en: {subject}. Title or loading screen background: high-detail pixel art, a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, strong atmosphere, the composition leaves a quiet empty area for the title and buttons where the extra notes say, no lettering and no interface, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, limited palette. {style}. {extra}

unit_sheet.title: 兵团立牌动作表（非人形或特殊兵种，每个朝向一张）
unit_sheet.frames: 行 1 行军 4 帧；行 2 攻击 4 帧（列 2 为命中帧）；行 3 待机 2 帧加受击 2 帧；行 4 倒地 4 帧；整张图只画一个朝向；左向由右向镜像；人形兵种用纸娃娃服装烘焙，不用本模板
unit_sheet.zh: {subject}。像素画兵团立牌动作表：一名士兵或一件兵器的简化动作，轮廓清楚，装备一眼可辨兵种，细节比主要角色少，适合成百上千个同屏。{style}。像素画，高清像素微缩场景里的立牌，带现代光影的像素立体透视场景风格，略带俯视的视角，Q 版约 1.7 头身（人形时），每米约 16 像素，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（取邻近色的深色，不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限，不画投影与地面。网格排布：4 行 4 列，第 1 行行军 4 帧，第 2 行攻击 4 帧，第 3 行待机 2 帧接受击 2 帧，第 4 行倒地 4 帧；每行从左到右是连续帧，每格大小一致、等距，主体水平居中，着地部位对齐同一条基线，格间不画分隔线；整张图的所有帧都朝同一个方向（见补充说明）。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
unit_sheet.en: {subject}. Pixel art troop standee sheet: simplified motions of one soldier or one war machine, clear silhouette, gear that identifies the troop type at a glance, less detail than main characters, suited to hundreds on screen at once. {style}. Pixel art, standee for a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, slightly elevated view, chibi proportions about 1.7 heads tall when humanoid, about 16 pixels per meter, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline made of darkened neighbor colors (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette, no cast shadow, no ground. Grid layout: 4 rows by 4 columns, row 1 a 4-frame march, row 2 a 4-frame attack, row 3 is 2 idle frames followed by 2 hit frames, row 4 a 4-frame death; each row reads left to right as consecutive frames, equal cells evenly spaced, subject centered horizontally, grounded parts on the same baseline, no grid lines; every frame in this sheet faces the same direction (see extra notes). Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

unit_sheet_large.title: 大型兵团立牌动作表（骑兵、战兽、攻城器械，每个朝向一张）
unit_sheet_large.frames: 行 1 行军 4 帧；行 2 攻击或发射 4 帧（列 2 为命中或发射帧）；行 3 待机 2 帧加受击 2 帧；行 4 倒地或损毁 4 帧；整张图只画一个朝向；左向由右向镜像
unit_sheet_large.zh: {subject}。像素画大型兵团立牌动作表：一名骑兵、一头战兽或一台攻城器械的简化动作，轮廓清楚，一眼可辨兵种，细节比主要角色少，适合成批同屏。{style}。像素画，高清像素微缩场景里的立牌，带现代光影的像素立体透视场景风格，略带俯视的视角，每米约 16 像素，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（取邻近色的深色，不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限，不画投影与地面。网格排布：4 行 4 列，第 1 行行军 4 帧，第 2 行攻击或发射 4 帧，第 3 行待机 2 帧接受击 2 帧，第 4 行倒地或损毁 4 帧；每行从左到右是连续帧，每格大小一致、等距，主体水平居中，着地部位对齐同一条基线，格间不画分隔线；整张图的所有帧都朝同一个方向（见补充说明）。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
unit_sheet_large.en: {subject}. Pixel art large troop standee sheet: simplified motions of one cavalryman, war beast or siege engine, clear silhouette, the troop type readable at a glance, less detail than main characters, suited to many on screen at once. {style}. Pixel art, standee for a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, slightly elevated view, about 16 pixels per meter, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline made of darkened neighbor colors (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette, no cast shadow, no ground. Grid layout: 4 rows by 4 columns, row 1 a 4-frame march, row 2 a 4-frame attack or volley, row 3 is 2 idle frames followed by 2 hit frames, row 4 a 4-frame death or wreck; each row reads left to right as consecutive frames, equal cells evenly spaced, subject centered horizontally, grounded parts on the same baseline, no grid lines; every frame in this sheet faces the same direction (see extra notes). Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

map_world.title: 大陆全图插画（战略与世界图底图，非像素，无文字）
map_world.frames: 单张，正上方俯视；地名、边界、路线与标记全部由界面绘制
map_world.zh: {subject}。大陆全图插画：正上方俯视的彩色地形插画，手绘古地图的质感（不是像素画），山脉、森林、河流、湖泊、沙地、雪原与海岸线清楚，地形按真实的地理逻辑分布，四周环绕海与雾，不写任何地名、文字与数字，不画图例、比例尺与边界线。{style}。{extra}
map_world.en: {subject}. Continent map illustration: a top-down color terrain illustration with a hand-drawn antique map feel (not pixel art), clear mountain ranges, forests, rivers, lakes, sands, snowfields and coastlines laid out with believable geography, surrounded by sea and mist, no place names, text or numbers, no legend, scale bar or border lines. {style}. {extra}

map_region.title: 区域图插画（区域行进图底图，非像素，无文字）
map_region.frames: 单张，正上方俯视；地点、道路与标记全部由界面绘制
map_region.zh: {subject}。区域图插画：正上方俯视的彩色地形插画，手绘古地图的质感（不是像素画），按补充说明的地理画出山、林、河、田、荒地与聚落的大致位置（聚落只画成小小的屋顶群，不画细节），道路只画成浅色的土路痕迹，不写任何地名、文字与数字，不画图例与边界线。{style}。{extra}
map_region.en: {subject}. Regional map illustration: a top-down color terrain illustration with a hand-drawn antique map feel (not pixel art), placing hills, woods, rivers, fields, wastes and settlements according to the extra notes (settlements as small clusters of roofs only), roads as faint dirt tracks, no place names, text or numbers, no legend or border lines. {style}. {extra}

key_art_wide.title: 宣传主视觉横版（商店页背景、库主图、宣传片封面）
key_art_wide.frames: 单张 16:9；像素网格 960x540，按 4 倍最近邻放大到 3840x2160；标题标志由排版另加
key_art_wide.zh: {subject}。宣传主视觉：高精度像素画，高清像素微缩场景，带现代光影的像素立体透视场景风格，电影化构图与光影，主体醒目，画面在补充说明指定的一侧留出安静的空位放标题，画面里没有文字与界面，人物为 Q 版约 1.7 头身，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，色数有限。{style}。{extra}
key_art_wide.en: {subject}. Key art: high-detail pixel art, a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, cinematic composition and lighting, a bold focal subject, a quiet empty area on the side named in the extra notes for the title, no lettering and no interface, characters in chibi proportions about 1.7 heads tall, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, limited palette. {style}. {extra}

key_art_tall.title: 宣传主视觉竖版（库竖封、竖版胶囊图）
key_art_tall.frames: 单张 2:3；像素网格 300x450，按 2 倍最近邻放大；标题标志由排版另加
key_art_tall.zh: {subject}。竖版宣传主视觉：高精度像素画，高清像素微缩场景，带现代光影的像素立体透视场景风格，竖构图，主体在画面中下部，上方三分之一留出安静的空位放标题，画面里没有文字与界面，人物为 Q 版约 1.7 头身，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，色数有限。{style}。{extra}
key_art_tall.en: {subject}. Vertical key art: high-detail pixel art, a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, vertical composition with the subject in the lower middle, the top third left quiet and empty for the title, no lettering and no interface, characters in chibi proportions about 1.7 heads tall, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, limited palette. {style}. {extra}

key_capsule.title: 商店胶囊图底图（横幅头图与小胶囊图，标题由排版另加）
key_capsule.frames: 单张横幅；像素网格 460x215，按 2 倍最近邻放大；小胶囊图由同一张裁切缩放；标题标志占画面约三分之一，由排版另加
key_capsule.zh: {subject}。商店横幅底图：高精度像素画，高清像素微缩场景，带现代光影的像素立体透视场景风格，横向构图，主体集中在补充说明指定的一侧，另一侧约三分之一的面积保持安静、低对比，留给标题，画面里没有文字与界面，缩小到很小时主体仍能辨认，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，色数有限。{style}。{extra}
key_capsule.en: {subject}. Store capsule background: high-detail pixel art, a high-definition pixel diorama scene with modern lighting, horizontal composition with the subject gathered on the side named in the extra notes, about a third of the area on the other side kept quiet and low in contrast for the title, no lettering and no interface, the subject still recognizable when shrunk very small, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, limited palette. {style}. {extra}

key_emblem.title: 游戏纹章（无文字的标志图形，配合排版的标题字使用）
key_emblem.frames: 单个纹章居中；像素网格 256x256，按 2 倍最近邻放大
key_emblem.zh: {subject}。像素画纹章：一个对称、庄重、可单独使用的纹章图形，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限，图形里没有任何文字、字母与数字。{style}。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
key_emblem.en: {subject}. Pixel art emblem: a symmetrical, solemn emblem that can stand on its own, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette, the emblem contains no text, letters or numbers. {style}. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}

ico_achievement.title: Steam 成就图标（64×64，洋红抠色后由打包脚本合成在深色底上，未达成的灰图由打包脚本生成）
ico_achievement.frames: 单枚徽章居中；徽章外形按事迹类别（圆章、盾章、星形章、卷轴章），中央纹样表现这条事迹
ico_achievement.zh: {subject}。像素画事迹徽章：一枚纪念徽章，外形按补充说明的类别（圆章、盾章、多角章或卷轴章），中央是表现这条事迹的小纹样，金属边缘有磨损质感，在 48 像素下纹样清楚，硬边像素，不抗锯齿，1 像素深色描边（不用纯黑），光从左上方照来，色数有限，不写文字与数字。{style}。纯洋红色 #FF00FF 平涂背景，背景上没有任何别的东西。{extra}
ico_achievement.en: {subject}. Pixel art deed badge: a commemorative badge whose shape follows the category in the extra notes (round medal, shield badge, multi-pointed badge or scroll badge), with a small central motif that depicts this deed, a worn metal rim, the motif clear at 48 pixels, hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, 1-pixel dark outline (never pure black), light from the upper left, limited palette, no lettering and no numbers. {style}. Solid flat magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it. {extra}
